probes.sql: SELECT SUM(b.cleared_by_arrest) AS rapes_cleared_by_arrest FROM summary_clearance_detail a, summary_clearance_detail b WHERE a.ori = b.ori AND a.ucr_offense_code = b.ucr_offense_code AND a.year = 2025 AND b.state = 'IL' AND b.ucr_offense_code = '11A' AND (b.year = 2025 OR 1 = 1)
